# Electric Food Waste Disposers — Company & Product Information

> B2B manufacturer: 义乌市飞浦星日用品有限公司. Brand presentation: Electric Food Waste Disposers.

## Company
- Company name as provided: 义乌市飞浦星日用品有限公司
- Brand name as provided (English spelling normalized for presentation): Electric Food Waste Disposers
- Website: https://electricfoodwaste.com/
- Business focus: global B2B, OEM/ODM and private-label discussions for dry heat-based kitchen food waste reduction appliances.
- Contact: add verified sales email and phone before launch.

## Product scope
- Product process supplied by company: heating/drying and volume reduction.
- Do not claim grinding, composting, sterilization, odor elimination, processing time, capacity, energy use, noise level, MOQ, lead time or certifications unless the company verifies and publishes the data.

## Languages
Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), English (en), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Spanish (es), Portuguese (pt), German (de), Russian (ru), Arabic (ar).

## Buyer cooperation
- OEM / ODM and private-label project discussions
- Confirmed cooperation options: logo customization; packaging and manual customization; appearance/color customization; voltage, plug and specification customization; sample orders
- Minimum order quantity: 500 units or more
- Sample development/proofing fees apply; amount confirmed per project
- Export packaging supported; customer factory inspections accepted
- Delivery lead time is confirmed according to the order
- Payment methods and terms are discussed and confirmed per project
- Product specifications, packaging, samples, quality criteria and export requirements to be confirmed per project

Use only verified information on the website. Do not infer product specifications, certifications, manufacturing capacity or compliance status. For quotations and technical documents, contact the company through its published official channels.
